learning_outcomes.text: Explain why RAG grounds model answers in external data and when it beats fine-tuning
Describe the RAG pipeline: ingest, chunk, embed, index, retrieve and generate
Build a basic retrieval step and pass retrieved context into a prompt
Write prompts that use retrieved context and cite sources faithfully
Identify common RAG failures such as missing context and ignored context
Measure retrieval and answer quality with simple, honest metrics

integrative_case: A support team wants a bot that answers only from their product documentation and never invents policy: design the ingest-chunk-embed-index path, build retrieval into the prompt with source citation, handle 'not found' honestly, and measure both retrieval hit-rate and answer grounding.
